subject: Proposal: Portfolio Headcount Consolidation & Offer Prioritization
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rebecca Stone <rebecca@talentpartners.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Portfolio Headcount Consolidation & Offer Prioritization

Team / Rebecca,

Following the leadership guidance to tighten new hire spend this quarter, I pulled together a proposed consolidation of open requisitions across Product & Platform. The goal is to temporarily reallocate headcount into a smaller set of priority hires we actually need in the next 60 days while pausing less time-sensitive reqs.

Attached: headcount_recon_v2.xlsx (recon of open reqs by team + suggested reallocations).

High-level ask:
- Approve pausing 12 non-critical reqs for 90 days (list in tab 'Pause Candidates').
- Prioritize 6 roles for offers this month (customer-facing infra, infra SRE, one PM).
- Allow up to two band exceptions for mission-critical hires but cap offer uplift at +7% unless Vivek approves higher.

Why this approach?
- Cuts projected near-term spend while protecting product roadmaps for Q3 launches.
- Keeps momentum on hires that unblock revenue-critical work.

Rebecca: can you confirm pipeline counts for the prioritized roles and estimated time-to-offer if we greenlight these today?
Monica/Laura: please confirm routing for band exception approvals and any finance checkpoints we need before extending offers.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

------

From: Rebecca Stone <rebecca@talentpartners.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Portfolio Headcount Consolidation & Offer Prioritization

Thanks Ben — reviewed the recon. A few notes from TalentPartners:

- Pipeline snapshot (as of this morning):
  - Infra SRE (PRD-231): 8 active candidates (3 strong, 2 in final rounds).
  - Customer-facing Infra Eng (PRD-245): 5 active (1 pending reference).
  - Product Manager (PROD-18): 6 active (2 have comp expectations above band).

- Time-to-offer if prioritized today:
  - SRE: 7–12 days (final-round scheduling depends on hiring manager availability).
  - Infra Eng: 10–18 days.
  - PM: 14–21 days (expect negotiation on comp).

Question on bands: do you want us to keep candidates within published band ranges and escalate exceptions only for the two mission-critical roles? We can flag those candidates with expectation mismatches and present options (sign-on, equity mix) to stay within comp targets.

Attachment: candidate_pipeline_snapshot_20270613.pdf (sent in candidate portal).

Rebecca Stone
Recruiting Partner, TalentPartners LLC
rebecca@talentpartners.com | (617) 555-0199

------

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Portfolio Headcount Consolidation & Offer Prioritization

Ben / team — thanks for the analysis. Narrow guidance from Exec: we must reduce new-hire run-rate this quarter by 18% vs plan. That means any pause decisions should prioritize roles that are not customer-facing or that can be covered by contractors for up to 3 months.

Directive:
- Approve pausing all non-customer-facing product reqs flagged in the recon for 90 days.
- Prioritize offers for roles that directly affect revenue/SLA commitments (mark those in the spreadsheet in red).
- Band exceptions: limit to two hires and route final approval through Finance (Laura); any exception >7% must come to me with documented business case.

Laura — please confirm whether Finance needs formal PO numbers or a one-line budget memo to clear exceptions. Monica — please work with Rebecca to prepare a short mutual action plan for each prioritized role so offer teams have clear milestones (interview, final decision, offer).

Vivek
VP, Platform Operations
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

------

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Stone <rebecca@talentpartners.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Portfolio Headcount Consolidation & Offer Prioritization

Adding the mutual action plan and a pragmatic timeline. Attached: offer_prioritization_guidelines.pdf (includes step-by-step approvals and template memo for Finance).

Summary plan (for prioritized 6 roles):
- Day 0 (approval): Talent confirm pipeline and committed interviewers.
- Day 7: Final interviews completed for top candidates.
- Day 10–12: Hiring manager decisions and offer package drafted.
- Day 14–18: Offers extended and negotiations concluded (aim to close 70% of prioritized cohort).

Quick bullets:
- Use sign-on and equity rebalancing before increasing base salary beyond band cap.
- Any >7% band uplift requires a one-paragraph business case and Laura's finance sign-off.
- Pause notices: we will message impacted sourcers and candidates with a standard template (I included draft copy in the PDF).

Next steps: Rebecca — update the pipeline doc with candidate readiness tag (green/amber/red) by EOD Thursday. Laura — can you confirm the finance memo format by EOD Wednesday so we can enforce a consistent process for exceptions?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Director, Talent & Recruiting Operations
monica.patel@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0166

------

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Stone <rebecca@talentpartners.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Portfolio Headcount Consolidation & Offer Prioritization

All — good alignment. Final confirmation items before I push to Exec:
1) Rebecca confirms pipeline readiness tags by 06/17 EOD.
2) Laura confirms finance memo template (one-line) by 06/16 EOD — Laura, if you need more time, say so and I will escalate.
3) Monica will circulate the pause messaging to sourcers for review.

If we have those three items in place I will mark the recon as approved and notify managers to hold paused reqs. We will let the prioritized roles proceed to offer, with Finance and Vivek as final checkpoints for any exceptions.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
